title: soliva minuta
intro: Soliva minuta, commonly known as dwarf snapwort or lesser snapwort, is a small annual plant belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Soliva minuta include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as pain and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Soliva minuta include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
